source: public official Premier League frontend SDP production API
purpose: Determine actual field availability before collecting or qualifying historical FPL inputs
request_policy: Anonymous public read; no authentication; preserve response bytes, URL, status and hash; no retry or bypass on access denial. Derive IDs and further paths from observed code and response only.
qualification_policy: No ledger or canonical writes before fixed full control gate passes. Keeper CBI must explain all six native vetoes and pass existing complete controls; no majority substitution. Alternate model xG is not native FPL xG. Season leaderboard alone does not establish per-match values.
